messages:
Priya R: Customer asks for per-route billing + deterministic 99th traces for hot routes pre-GA. They want early cost-regression detection.

Alex M: Confirming: full 99th capture for top N routes only? Or sampling+trigger?

Priya R: Top 10 routes deterministic 99th capture; sampling elsewhere.

Samir K: We can enable full KV/trace dumps for those routes during short windows. Need token-cost estimate.

Elaine: Estimate: full payload for 0.1% of peak requests ~ +12% tokens on those routes. Deterministic tail needs higher coverage for short windows.

Alex M: Proposal: 24h deterministic window for top10, otherwise 0.1% sampling.

Priya R: Also request: console line-item by route + model in billing UI.

Kate (ops): Backend needs route_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_version emitted. UI tile + drilldown required.

Samir K: Aggregators usually drop route tags; we can preserve them behind a flag for selected routes.

Alex M: Proto: emit metric route.cost_tokens{route,model}. Console converts to $ via model price table.

Priya R: Launch criteria draft: 1) per-route cost metric for top100, 2) 99th trace canary for top10, 3) docs+runbook, 4) cost-regression alert >20% MoM.

Elaine: Add auto-disable if 99th trace capture increases token use >30% with notification.

Kate (ops): Estimate: backend 2 engs x2 sprints, frontend 1 eng x1 sprint, docs 0.5 sprint. Dependencies: telemetry schema, runtime flag, billing calc change.

Alex M: Risks: sampling mismatch, data blowup, CSV export requests.

Samir K: Mitigations: conservative default routes, customer opt-in, per-org trace token quota.

Priya R: Offer pilot to customer: 24h deterministic + cost cap + weekly sync. If successful, include in GA.

Priya R: Action items: Priya->pilot SOW Wed; Samir->runtime flag prototype EOW; Alex->mock tile Tue; Kate->scope billing calc. 30m sync Fri.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create sprint ticket 'obs: per-route cost metric' when ready (link placeholder).
